Untitled UI Icons — The Ultimate Figma Icon Library

name: Untitled UI Icons
summary: Icon library of 4,600+ Figma icons in four styles, with a free SVG set and one-time PRO licenses.
description: A neutral icon library crafted for modern UI design, built as Figma components and organized into 19 categories. The free tier includes 1,100+ line icons; the PRO library adds duocolor, duotone and solid styles across 4,600+ icons, with optimized SVG exports, an IconJar library, master icons with live corners and access through a private npm. React icon components are also available.
contains: Free tier: 1,100+ line icons as SVG and a Figma library
PRO one-time licenses: $79 solo, $199 studio, $499 business, $1,199 enterprise
Exports: optimized SVGs, IconJar library, master icons with live corners, private npm
